x402 is a new open payment protocol developed by Coinbase that enables instant, automatic stablecoin payments directly over HTTP.
By reviving the HTTP 402 Payment Required status code, x402 lets services monetize APIs and digital content onchain, allowing clients, both human and machine, to programmatically pay for access without accounts, sessions, or complex authentication.

casts.author: quazia
rish

casts.text:
Great! So limit to a reasonably small number, adjust it dynamically based on your load if it's really a problem. 

It's definitely not cheaper to get thousands of IPs than to pay for the x402 metering.

The point is that even 10-100 requests per day or week is plenty for these kinds of tooling use cases, and it's a convenient "try for free before you start paying" which gracefully upgrades to x402.

This is a core scenario that x402 was designed for from the start (not just for "always-paid" endpoints).
